mapper.select: select id,user_id,product_id,quantity,checked,create_time,update_time from cart where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
select id,user_id,product_id,quantity,checked,create_time,update_time from cart where user_id = #{userId} and checked = 1 order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into cart(user_id, product_id, quantity, checked, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{checked}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update cart set quantity = #{quantity}, checked = #{checked}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from cart where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId}
delete from cart where user_id = #{userId} and checked = 1
